risks.risk: Brake condition (pads/rotors/drums) and braking performance may be poor even if it looks okay from afar.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of both brake calipers/pads (and front/rear brake area) plus a short video of braking while riding/rolling.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if brakes need service/parts (worst case: not fully working).

risks.risk: Gear shifting may be misadjusted or worn (derailleur/cassette/chain), causing skipping or poor indexing.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rear derailleur and shifter, plus a short video showing gear changes across all gears.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if gears are not perfect (worst case: needs adjustment/possible chain/cassette wear).

risks.risk: Hidden rust/corrosion on chain, spokes, bottom bracket, and brake hardware.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the chain, cassette/freewheel area, spoke nipples, and any rust-prone joints.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if there is some corrosion requiring cleaning/replacement (worst case: parts may need replacement).

risks.risk: Wheel alignment and tire condition (sidewall cracks, tread wear, wobble) not verifiable from one wide shot.
risks.proof: Photos of both wheels straight-on and a video rolling the bike to show wobble; close-up of tire tread and sidewalls.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if tires/alignment may need work (worst case: tire replacement).

risks.risk: Bike model/size and component specs unknown, which affects fair Lagos pricing.
risks.proof: Photo of the frame/model label (near bottom bracket or seat tube) and a full side profile with size markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used adult bicycle with unknown specs (worst case for value).

proof_requests: Send close-up photos: front brake area, rear brake area, rear derailleur + shifter, chain/cassette/freewheel, and both wheel hubs/spokes.
Send a short video: bike being ridden/rolled while shifting through all gears and braking hard safely.
Send a photo of any frame/model label or serial number (for exact identification) and a full side view showing wheel size/overall condition.
response.reason: From photo 0, the bicycle type is visible but the key value drivers (brakes, gear indexing, rust level, and exact model/spec/size) are not verifiable remotely. To price confidently in Lagos, the decisive close-ups and a shifting/braking video are needed.
